summary: Elevra Lithium Ltd filed a Form 6-K attaching an Appendix 3G notification of issue of 2,160 unquoted performance rights under an employee incentive scheme, issued on June 30, 2026. No price, premium, or board recommendation is involved; the securities were approved at the November 2025 AGM and are not intended for trading. This is a routine equity compensation disclosure, not a special situation. The filing also includes a general quarterly production and sales update. There are no deal terms, strategic changes, or extraordinary corporate actions to analyze.
